items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 45:1
items.html: The fillings of the Names hint at the phases of coarseness and screens over which the upper light couples, drawing out the level of the ten Sefirot according to the measure of their coarseness, as is known. However, when they are not in the secret of the coupling, the fillings are discerned as being without the Names, and then they are a phase of judgments. This is the hint that the filling equals Elokim in gematria: when they are without the Name they are judgments, for the name Elokim indicates judgments; but when they are in the secret of the coupling — that is, with the Name — then, on the contrary, they are in the secret of mercy, the phase of HaVaYaH. (1:25, Item 33)
